title: Saturday diversion: a temporary bus stop
titleZh: 星期六改道：公車臨時站
passage:
Route 8 rider notice
Subject: Saturday stop diversion

Road work will close the curb beside East Library on Saturday. The bus will still run on its usual schedule, but it will no longer stop there. A sign at the closed curb will [139] ____ riders to the temporary stop behind the library.

The temporary stop can be reached from Lake Street. Riders [140] ____ cannot use stairs should instead board at Garden Gate, where a ramp connects the bus entrance and exit to the sidewalk. The bus visits Garden Gate two minutes after its scheduled library departure.

The temporary stop is for boarding only; it cannot be used to get off the bus. [141] ____

The Sunday schedule and stop locations are [142] ____; the diversion applies on Saturday only.

八號公車乘車通知
主旨：星期六站點改道

星期六道路施工，東圖書館旁的路邊站將封閉。公車仍按平常的時刻行駛，但不會停靠該處。封閉站點的標示會 [139] ____ 乘客前往圖書館後方的臨時站。

可以從湖街抵達臨時站。無法走樓梯的 [140] ____應改到花園門站上車，那裡有坡道，可從人行道上車，也可由車上通往人行道。公車會在圖書館原定發車時間兩分鐘後抵達花園門站。

臨時站只供上車，不提供下車。[141] ____

星期日的時刻表和站點 [142] ____；改道僅限星期六。
